required.quote: Each applicant shall be examined to determine the applicant's (1) ability to understand plans, design specifications, and engineering terms commonly used in the electrical field; (2) knowledge of electrical installations and wiring; (3) familiarity with the regulations contained in the National Electrical Code and the National Electrical Safety Code

exams.name: Electrical Administrator Licensing Examination
exams.notes: Covers ability to understand plans/specifications, knowledge of electrical installations and wiring, familiarity with National Electrical Code and National Electrical Safety Code, and personal skill and ability. Offered at least twice per year.
exams.quote: A licensing examination shall be offered by the department at least twice during each year at appropriate places in the state.

interval_years.quote: Licenses shall be renewed biennially on the dates set by the department with the approval of the respective board.

required.quote: the department shall adopt regulations subject to AS 44.62 (Administrative Procedure Act), relating to the examination and licensing of electrical administrators and the establishing of the continued competency of an applicant for license renewal and reinstatement.

available.quote: If an applicant for a license submits proof satisfactory to the department that the applicant is licensed as an electrical administrator or the equivalent by another state or territory, that the applicant meets qualifications established by the department under AS 08.40.045, and that the applicant has passed an examination equivalent to the test administered under (a) of this section, the department shall waive all of the examination required under (a) of this section.

requirements.value: Applicant must show they are licensed as an electrical administrator or equivalent in another state or territory, meet department qualifications, and have passed an equivalent examination. The department then waives the licensing examination.
